palindrome:
A palindrome is a word or phrase that reads the same backward as forward. Here is an example of a palindrome with over 255 characters:

"Never odd or even, no lemon, no melon. Was it a car or a cat I saw? I saw a cat or a car, no lemon, no melon. Odd was I saw, never odd or even."

This sentence contains 106 characters and is a palindrome when spaces are removed.
